procedure: Inspect all completed traces before reading aggregate effect numbers where possible. Analyst sees arm and execution events; no claim of independent blinded reviewer.

rubric.attribution: A multi-change patch does not identify a single causal mechanism. Distinct generation seeds producing identical predictions are not independent training replication.
rubric.benefit: Only the frozen numerical readout can establish retained-score differences; code inspection never substitutes for it.
rubric.grounding: Does the initial plan correctly reference actual existing components/variables and observations? Do not equate asserted causality with evidence.
rubric.implementation: Compare stated change with executed code; label implemented/partial/not implemented/unknown. Execution success alone is not implementation proof.
rubric.known_rules: Check objective/metric alignment, supported early stopping, public CV member/blend selection, train-fitted preprocessing, standard text views/regularized models. Beyond this checklist is not proof of novelty.
rubric.preservation: Explicitly list non-target alterations, unnecessary retraining, or incompatible interfaces; missing evidence is unknown.

timing: Post-launch, before inspection of model responses or numerical effects. Does not change original numerical gate.
units: All assigned roots and comparisons, including failures and unstarted positions.
